items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Every time, I'm doing something with Dexter or Gene Hammond [phonetic sp.] or something, it's always, you know.

ctx.x: -- think you ought to work with -- I think you ought to bring this guy into -- ?

-- well, they wanted -- they wanted to do that, too. I want to make my album, they say, "Well, I think you outta have a guest artist." I says, "Yeah, I want to do it myself." Every time I look, they had me doing something with Dexter Gordon [phonetic sp.]. You know, like every time -- I say, "Godda -- I mean, dammit, why don't you let me do something?" Every time, I'm doing something with Dexter or Gene Hammond [phonetic sp.] or something, it's always, you know.
Was that when you were with Chess, or?
